question: What is the ship id and name that caused most total injuries?

candidates.label: A
candidates.sql: SELECT T1."id", T1."name" FROM "ship" AS T1 INNER JOIN "death" AS T2 ON T1."id" = T2."caused_by_ship_id" GROUP BY T1."id" ORDER BY SUM(T2."injured") DESC LIMIT 1
candidates.result: 1 row x 2 cols (integer, text); first: (4, 'HMS Avon')

candidates.label: B

candidates.result: 1 row x 2 cols (integer, text); first: (5, 'HMS Avon')

question: List the name and date the battle that has lost  Lettice and HMS Atalanta

candidates.label: A
candidates.sql: SELECT T1."name", T1."date" FROM "battle" AS T1 INNER JOIN "ship" AS T2 ON T1."id" = T2."lost_in_battle" WHERE T2."name" IN ('Lettice', 'HMS Atalanta')
candidates.result: 2 rows x 2 cols (text, text); first: ('Siege of Constantinople', '1235')

question: Show names, results and bulgarian commanders of the battles with no ships lost in the 'English Channel'.

candidates.label: A
candidates.sql: SELECT "name", "result", "bulgarian_commander" FROM "battle" WHERE "id" IN (SELECT "lost_in_battle" FROM "ship" WHERE "location" = 'English Channel')
candidates.result: 5 rows x 3 cols (text, text, text); first: ('Battle of Rodosto', 'Bulgarian victory', 'Kaloyan')

candidates.label: B
candidates.sql: SELECT T1."name", T1."result", T1."bulgarian_commander" FROM "battle" AS T1 INNER JOIN "ship" AS T2 ON T1."id" = T2."lost_in_battle" WHERE T2."lost_in_battle" = (SELECT "lost_in_battle" FROM "ship" WHERE "location" = 'English Channel') AND T2."location" = 'English Channel'
candidates.result: 1 row x 3 cols (text, text, text); first: ('Siege of Constantinople', 'Two Year Truce', 'Ivan Asen II')

candidates.label: C
candidates.sql: SELECT T1."name", T1."bulgarian_commander", T1."result" FROM "battle" AS T1 INNER JOIN "ship" AS T2 ON T1."id" = T2."lost_in_battle" WHERE T2."location" = 'English Channel'
candidates.result: 5 rows x 3 cols (text, text, text); first: ('Siege of Constantinople', 'Ivan Asen II', 'Two Year Truce')

candidates.label: D
candidates.sql: SELECT T1."name", T1."result", T1."bulgarian_commander" FROM "battle" AS T1 INNER JOIN "ship" AS T2 ON T1."id" = T2."lost_in_battle" WHERE T2."location" = 'English Channel' AND T2."lost_in_battle" != (SELECT "lost_in_battle" FROM "ship" WHERE "location" = 'English Channel')

candidates.label: E
candidates.sql: SELECT T1."name", T1."result", T1."latin_commander" FROM "battle" AS T1 INNER JOIN "ship" AS T2 ON T1."id" = T2."lost_in_battle" WHERE T2."location" = 'English Channel' AND T2."lost_in_battle" IS NOT NULL
